lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's BOCC meeting, where the county takes up two Land Use Code amendments — one on Natural Medicine Businesses and one on Nonconforming Lots — the kind of code changes that quietly set the rules for years to come. That same day, HARC holds public hearings on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave, a large-scale new construction project across multiple buildings in Backman Village. Monday afternoon, the Open Space Commission heads to the Valley Floor for a weed pull with public comment open to anyone who shows up.

notable.stake: Public hearings on large-scale Carhenge redevelopment — multiple new buildings up for review.
